metadata.proving_policy: fresh Node/WASM process per sample, keys initialized outside combined witness+prove; no pk_decode metric
metadata.memory_method: whole-process peak footprint and RSS; not browser linear-memory capacity

backend_notes.chonk: Exact PR Chonk app + registry/kernel/hiding fold
backend_notes.groth16: Arkworks Groth16: shared ACIR application relations and private link equalities; canonical compressed proof
backend_notes.provekit: ProveKit low-level WHIR over the same merged R1CS; non-SPARK verifier retains full R1CS

metadata.qualification: Integration smoke observations: one proving sample per configuration, not a stabilized performance baseline. Some samples overlapped development/build/browser activity. Use the documented five-sample command on an otherwise idle device for analysis.
